Thanks Emily — appreciate the context. Looping in Jonas (partner ops) and Marissa (sales lead) to validate the ops path and impact on co-sell credits. High-level thoughts below.

Option A — Repool in ledger (preferred if allowed):
- Move 40% of remaining committed USD to a shared ledger that covers Project B usage.
- Minimal SKU changes; invoicing remains monthly against the same private-offer ID.
- Likely no impact on co-sell eligibility if the underlying purchase & customer identity remain the same.

Option B — Partial SKU remapping (fallback):
- Create a negative/positive offset by remapping part of the offer to Project B SKUs.
- Requires confirmation from GCP Partner Ops and may trigger amended invoice line items.

Actions I need from DataForge:
1) Formal confirmation on authorized approver and exact USD amounts per project (spreadsheet helps).
2) PO or email from procurement authorizing the split.

I've attached a quick ops worksheet with a sample repool (repool-scenario-ops.xlsx). Jonas — can you confirm which path GCP will accept and whether DocuSign or an amended PO is required? Marissa — I can draft a short MAP (mutual action plan) for signatures & timelines once we pick the path.

Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Connor / Marissa / Emily — quick ops check.

We can support a repool but there are three operational constraints to call out:
1) GCP Marketplace private offers are tie-to-offer-id; repooling internally is possible if the marketplace partner (us) and the customer agree to an internal ledger update, but we must route through the Partner Central change control.
2) If the repool changes SKU mappings or billing project IDs, invoices will show amended lines; that can affect QBR reporting.
3) Co-sell credit: GCP will evaluate total consumption against the original purchase. If the contract is unchanged and it's an internal reallocation, co-sell shouldn't be impacted — but we need a confirmation from the Google rep.

Recommended execution (fastest):
- Emily sends an authorization email from procurement and the split spreadsheet.
- We submit a Partner Central change request (I can own this ticket).
- If Partner Central requires signature, we push DocuSign via the template linked below.

Internal runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-DataForge-PrivateOffer-Runbook
DocuSign template: https://docusign.com/templates/df-commit-split-2027

Connor — please share the signed authorizer and I'll open the change request. Emily — is your procurement team OK sending the sign-off by tomorrow EOD?

—Jonas
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
